column3: “the men of Israel” renders the collective “the man of Israel”; “in marriage” renders “to a wife.”
“voices” renders the Hebrew singular “voice”; “wept bitterly” renders “wept a great weeping.”
“utterly destroy” renders the verb for devoting to destruction; “lain with a man” renders “known the lying of a male.”
“they were not enough for them” renders “they did not find so for them.”
“There must be an inheritance for the survivors” renders “a possession of the escaped remnant belongs to Benjamin.”
“from year to year” renders “from days to days.”
NASB supplies “watch” as a separate verb; “catch” renders “seize.”
The Hebrew of this verse is difficult; “Give them to us voluntarily” renders “show us favor with them,” and “else you would now be guilty” renders “at this time you would be guilty.”
